ACK f11fc55f41b416638cb0405d0bef9162655ebcaf
Tested with both mutants and the results are as expected.

I've added a non-blocking suggestion to add the case of an in-range timestamp, the case is covered as a side effect on other test but has no explicit coverage and I think it will be nice to have.
Thanks @nebula-21 for reviewing! I believe in-range cases are already well tested, so I'd rather keep this test focused on the out-of-range branches.
